973544.name: Malai Lassi
973544.description: Refresh your palate with our Malai Lassi, the ultimate creamy indulgence. 1033036.name: Halka Jhaler Beef Chaap with Polao
1033036.description: Savor the perfect blend of tradition and comfort. Our succulent beef chaap is slow-cooked in a signature "halka jhal" (mildly spiced) marinade, offering a gentle, flavorful heat that perfectly complements the rich, tender meat. Served with a generous portion of aromatic, fluffy polao, this hearty duo is a timeless classic crafted to satisfy your cravings.

1033070.name: Bhai Special Mutton Tehari
1033070.description: Indulge in our signature Bhai Special Mutton Tehari, a masterpiece of traditional flavor. We slow-cook tender, succulent mutton pieces with a proprietary blend of aromatic spices until they are melt-in-your-mouth perfect. Infused into every grain of our premium, fragrant rice, the bold, savory depth of the meat creates an unforgettable, authentic experience. It’s a rich, hearty, and nostalgic plate of comfort that defines the true essence of classic Tehari.

1033091.name: Bhai Special Mutton Tehari with Borhani
1033091.description: Enjoy the rich, aromatic depth of our slow-cooked mutton, expertly infused into every grain of premium, spiced rice. To balance the bold, savory indulgence of the Tehari, we serve it with our signature chilled Borhani—a tangy, herb-infused yogurt drink that cleanses the palate and makes every bite feel as vibrant as the first. It is the ultimate pairing for a complete, satisfying, and authentically traditional feast.

177025.name: Doi
177025.description: Complete your meal on a refreshing note with our Traditional Sweet Doi. Expertly set to a smooth, velvety consistency, this classic dessert offers the perfect balance of creamy richness and subtle sweetness. Chilled to perfection, it is the ultimate palate cleanser and a quintessential end to any hearty, spice-filled feast. Enjoy the authentic, melt-in-your-mouth experience that only premium, farm-fresh curd can provide.

1032757.name: Shahi Rabri Jamun
1032757.description: Indulge in the ultimate royal treat: our Shahi Rabri Jamun. We take soft, melt-in-your-mouth gulab jamuns—fried to a perfect golden brown and soaked in aromatic, cardamom-infused syrup—and nestle them into a pool of thick, creamy, and chilled rabri. Each spoonful offers a decadent contrast between the warm, syrupy sweetness of the jamun and the rich, nutty, and velvety texture of the slow-reduced milk. It’s an opulent dessert experience, perfectly balanced and crafted for those who truly appreciate a grand finale to their meal.

1032983.name: Halka Jhaler Beef Chaap
1032983.description: Experience the perfect balance of spice and tenderness with our Halka Jhaler Beef Chaap. We take succulent, premium cuts of beef and marinate them in a secret blend of aromatic spices, slow-cooking them until the meat is incredibly tender. Prepared "Halka Jhal" style, it offers a gentle, flavorful warmth that highlights the richness of the beef without being overwhelming. Deeply savory and perfectly charred, this is a must-try classic for those who appreciate authentic, well-balanced heat.

973520.name: Malai Lassi
973520.description: Refresh your palate with our Malai Lassi, the ultimate creamy indulgence. We blend thick, farm-fresh yogurt with a touch of sweetness to create a smooth, velvety base, then crown it with a generous dollop of rich, luscious cream (malai). Every sip is cool, deeply satisfying, and perfectly textured—making it the ideal accompaniment to balance the bold spices of your meal or a delightful treat on its own.

11397.name: Kacchi Khadok

1032984.name: Halka Jhaler Beef Chaap
1032984.description: Experience the perfect balance of spice and tenderness with our Halka Jhaler Beef Chaap. We take succulent, premium cuts of beef and marinate them in a secret blend of aromatic spices, slow-cooking them until the meat is incredibly tender. Prepared "Halka Jhal" style, it offers a gentle, flavorful warmth that highlights the richness of the beef without being overwhelming. Deeply savory and perfectly charred, this is a must-try classic for those who appreciate authentic, well-balanced heat.

1032752.name: Shahi Rabri Jamun
1032752.description: Indulge in the ultimate royal treat: our Shahi Rabri Jamun. We take soft, melt-in-your-mouth gulab jamuns—fried to a perfect golden brown and soaked in aromatic, cardamom-infused syrup—and nestle them into a pool of thick, creamy, and chilled rabri. Each spoonful offers a decadent contrast between the warm, syrupy sweetness of the jamun and the rich, nutty, and velvety texture of the slow-reduced milk. It’s an opulent dessert experience, perfectly balanced and crafted for those who truly appreciate a grand finale to their meal.

1033037.name: Halka Jhaler Beef Chaap with Polao
1033037.description: Savor the perfect blend of tradition and comfort. Our succulent beef chaap is slow-cooked in a signature "halka jhal" (mildly spiced) marinade, offering a gentle, flavorful heat that perfectly complements the rich, tender meat. Served with a generous portion of aromatic, fluffy polao, this hearty duo is a timeless classic crafted to satisfy your cravings.

1033071.name: Bhai Special Mutton Tehari
1033071.description: Indulge in our signature Bhai Special Mutton Tehari, a masterpiece of traditional flavor. We slow-cook tender, succulent mutton pieces with a proprietary blend of aromatic spices until they are melt-in-your-mouth perfect. Infused into every grain of our premium, fragrant rice, the bold, savory depth of the meat creates an unforgettable, authentic experience. It’s a rich, hearty, and nostalgic plate of comfort that defines the true essence of classic Tehari.

1033092.name: Bhai Special Mutton Tehari with Borhani
1033092.description: Enjoy the rich, aromatic depth of our slow-cooked mutton, expertly infused into every grain of premium, spiced rice. To balance the bold, savory indulgence of the Tehari, we serve it with our signature chilled Borhani—a tangy, herb-infused yogurt drink that cleanses the palate and makes every bite feel as vibrant as the first. It is the ultimate pairing for a complete, satisfying, and authentically traditional feast.
